delivery.outcome: A normative per-project Planfile and work-registration contract with a deterministic read-only checker and regressions exposes missing Issue, worktree, lease, PR and recovery bindings without granting execution authority.
nonGoals: No daemon, GitHub writer, scheduler or second ticket-ID allocator in wellmanifest.
No claim that the package, Goal controller or existing adopters already enforce this new contract.
No modification or deletion of historical branches or foreign ticket-198 work.

architecture.decision: Define a closed portable registration snapshot with a pinned repository-scoped Planfile installation, stable request identity, phase-aware bindings, durable idempotent recovery effects, and non-authoritative validation. Product controllers remain HOME in semcod/subactor; cross-boundary observations must be acquired independently. Documentation delivery also indexes the new canonical document and normalizes a pre-existing invalid relative evidence reference in the SQLite document to its immutable source URL.
architecture.rollback: Revert the additive contract/checker/tests/documentation; no production controller or adopter is changed.

validation.evidence: Pending fixtures for waiting work, exact repository bindings, missing/duplicate identities, stale leases and PR heads, recovery and orphan preservation.
Pending deterministic governance and protected publication.
